interpreters: Official x86/x64 release hashes match each extracted member exactly, including all code/resources and EOF. No RT_RCDATA script payload or overlay was added.

Upstream _tWinMain parses the command line, loads the selected/default script, checks prior instances, initializes execution and enters MainExecuteScript. This is an interpreter; scripts determine its operations.

Rizin x64 call 0x140041f30 and x86 0x4358bf allocate 0x858 remote bytes with PAGE_READWRITE (4); x64 0x140042103 writes an 88-byte control structure. Upstream ControlGetListView supplies the matching LVITEM behavior.

x64 0x1400a7ac9 and x86 0x486a86 allocate another 0x10000 PAGE_READWRITE buffer after obtaining a window owner and opening its process. Upstream AllocInterProcMem documents cross-process UI-control structures. These allocations are not evidence of executable shellcode.

Process enumeration, remote-memory APIs, keyboard/window hooks, clipboard, registry, network and process-launch primitives remain detected. The suspicious enumerated-remote-memory-write API profile is accurate and retained.

The CAB sidecar downloads shellcode via WinHttpRequest, creates rundll32/WmiPrvSE suspended, allocates RWX memory, writes the response, queues an APC and resumes its thread; timers retry unfinished jobs. Two alternate URLs are Base64 decoded. This describes the sidecar, not added interpreter code.

The PyInstaller wrapper copies named members including ahk.exe into Public Downloads; its separate loader bytecode extracts LSB data from the MP3-named blob, AES-CBC decrypts it, allocates RWX memory, copies shellcode and invokes a ctypes function pointer. Archive conviction is retained; this separate code does not alter ahk.exe.
python: Console entry zlibxjson_command maps to main:init. __init__.py only exports init; neither import nor package installation directly invokes it.
init reads APPDATA. When present it supplies the fixed Discord attachment executable URL and that directory to download_file; otherwise it prints a diagnostic.

download_file creates the directory if absent, strips the URL query to derive the basename, joins the destination, opens requests.get(stream=True), checks HTTP status and writes iter_content chunks to that same binary file.

The helper returns that path; init supplies it to run_silently; subprocess.Popen receives it with shell=True and CREATE_NO_WINDOW. Launch errors are printed. No executable signature/hash validation is present.
No obfuscation, persistence, credential access, exfiltration, escalation or cleanup exists in this member. These are not inferred from the unavailable downstream EXE.

changes.change: Rename two composites and descriptions to pixel operation references, preserving matchers, scope and severity. Native GetPixel does not establish .NET. All exact consumers updated; parent-selector membership is unchanged.
Update the sole external exact consumer of the renamed pixel aggregate. Required observations and attack coverage remain identical.

Correct two alleged spawn fragments to actual big-endian setting headers 29/30, TYPE_PTR 3, length 64, in .data. Retain component criticality because a header alone is incomplete. Include DLL carriers. Restrict dependent clauses to reachable Windows PE types.

unsupported_claim_and_consumer_review: At temp.exe file offset 0x18e2a (VA 0x419a2a), the old 00 0d 00 80 00 00 match straddles a branch displacement and OR EAX,0x8000 at 0x419a2b. It is not a Beacon configuration entry. The analogous old x64 fragment was also not a valid typed spawn record.

Exact references, config-directory selectors and enclosing Cobalt Strike selectors were inspected. The x86/x64 atoms feed cfg-spawn-any, cfg-sleep-with-spawn and config-block; those observations can in turn feed Beacon identities. Unsupported instruction coincidences must not supply that family context.

Dissect source defines 29/30 as spawn-path settings and TYPE_PTR as 3, with a big-endian index/type/length layout. Independent real upstream Beacon fixtures were unpacked/decrypted and their spawn records parsed before matcher repair.
No accurate remote-memory, process-execution, network, encoding or UI capability was suppressed on the benign interpreters. No identity exclusion or filename/hash allowlist was added.
recovery: forager --all-wheels pkg:pypi/zlibxjson@8.2: PyPI metadata 404; fallback failed because Chromium ICU data is unavailable. Original supplied wheel remained available and exact member equality was verified.

hostile_detection_goal.status: Not met for main.py: zero hostile and two suspicious traits before/after.
hostile_detection_goal.investigation: Inspected full source, import and console-entry behavior, streamed response/file/output/return/launch flow, APPDATA routing, host URL, shell parsing, console suppression, metadata and all available decoded facts. Exercised the existing ten boundary controls and attempted downstream recovery.
hostile_detection_goal.limit: The member implements one download/hidden-launch chain shared mechanically by legitimate updaters. Its package context tips the human verdict to MALICIOUS but does not justify three independent hostile behaviors or a name-based conviction rule. No missing independent behavior was found; later payload outcomes cannot be matched without the missing EXE.
hostile_detection_goal.classifier_gap: main.py and wheel retain probability 0.99525124, level 5000, confidence 54, a weak alert compared with the manual malicious judgment. The interpreters remain below the classifier alert grid (level -1), consistent with BENIGN; their retained suspicious capability is intentional.
